note: Adapted from the new-species description in Snyder (1925), original English; only the major and minor soldiers are treated, the alate and worker were not described (the worker is merely mentioned as collected with the soldiers). Type locality Pamua (San Cristobal Island, Solomon Islands), from a series of major and minor soldiers and workers collected by W. M. Mann in August (month 8) 1916; the major soldier holotype (Cat. No. 15292) is in the Museum of Comparative Zoology and the minor soldier is a morphotype. Measurements in mm, transcribed item by item from the original, ranges kept as printed.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Smaller than most species of the subgenus Rhinotermes (Schedorhinotermes).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head pale chestnut brown, frontal-gland area paler; posterior part of head square, sides narrowing sharply and converging forwards, posterior margin rounded. Fontanelle hyaline, circular, distinct, opening flat, situated on the line joining the two antennal sockets; a shallow groove runs from the fontanelle to the tip of the labrum, widening forwards, its margins darker than the head; head with sparse, scattered long hairs. Eye spots hyaline, nearly oval, near the edge of the depression around the antennal sockets. Labrum pale yellowish brown, grooved medially, tongue-shaped, longer than wide, apex bilobed, not reaching the mandibular apices, with a fringe of short hairs and scattered longer hairs. Postmentum about half as wide at the middle as at its widest anterior part. Mandibles pale chestnut brown at the base, red-brown apically, broad at the base, slender and incurved apically, apices pointed; left mandible with two subequal sharp marginal teeth near the middle; right mandible with one similar tooth situated between the two teeth of the left mandible. Antennae pale yellow, 16-segmented, segments becoming longer and wider and bearing long hairs towards the apex; segment 3 nearly clavate, longer than segment 2 or 4; segment 4 shorter than segment 2; terminal segment short, slender, nearly oval. Pronotum pale yellowish brown (margins darker), flat; anterior margin converging forwards on both sides, projecting at the middle; sides straight, narrowing posteriorly; posterior margin shallowly concave medially; margins with scattered long hairs. Legs yellowish, slender, with long hairs. Abdomen pale yellowish brown (straw yellow); tergites with short hairs and a row of long hairs at the base; cerci and styli distinct. Measurements: body length 4.5, head with mandibles 2.35, head length (without mandibles, to anterior margin) 1.5, left mandible length 0.95, pronotal length 0.5, hind tibia length 1.8, head height at middle 0.9, head width (posterior) 1.5, head width (anterior) 1.0, pronotal width 0.9 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Minor soldier: head yellowish brown (frontal-gland area paler), slightly arched; sides widening from the rounded posterior margin towards the antennal sockets, then narrowing towards the anterior margin. Fontanelle hyaline, circular, on the line between the antennae, a deep groove running from it to the tip of the labrum; coronal suture descending sharply forwards; a row of long hairs at the front and at the back of the head. Labrum pale chestnut brown, slightly longer than the mandibles, widest posteriorly; sides slightly concave; median groove deep, widening forwards; labral apex widened, terminal part hyaline and bilobed, with a dense fringe of short hairs and longer hairs. Mandibles yellow at the base, red-brown apically, slender, apices pointed and incurved; left mandible with two sharp marginal teeth in the apical third; right mandible with one tooth situated between the two teeth of the left mandible. Antennae pale yellowish brown, 15-segmented, becoming longer and wider and bearing long hairs towards the apex; segment 3 nearly clavate, short and narrow, shorter than segment 2 or 4; segment 4 shorter than segment 2; terminal segment short, slender, nearly oval. Pronotum yellowish brown; anterior margin convex, posterior margin concave medially; margins with long hairs. Legs pale yellow, slender, with long hairs. Abdomen yellowish brown (straw yellow); tergites with short hairs and a row of long hairs at the base; cerci distinct. Measurements: body length 3.7, head with mandibles 1.45—1.5, head length (without mandibles) 0.9, head with labrum 1.55—1.6, left mandible length 0.6, labrum length (with postclypeus) 0.65, pronotal length 0.35—0.40, hind tibia length 0.95, head height at middle 0.5, head width (at antennal sockets, widest) 0.8, pronotal width 0.55—0.6 mm.
